title: Feed the Beast
sub: Even though we give it our all for you and try to keep making music, it all comes at a cost. There are various ways you can support us. You can either become a patron and support us with 5.- a month or support us with a one-time donation. As a patron, you’ll enjoy a number of benefits, such as a better insight into our band, access to the party or gig at the end of the month and more...

cards.heading: Become a Patron
cards.blurb: Support your local band. Help us play as many gigs as possible. We need support to cover our rent, travel costs, equipment, the photographer, the videographer, etc. Simply set up a monthly standing order to our band account or support us regularly via TWINT. If you can spare 5 CHF a month, we’ll play even louder just for you.
bullets: End of the Month Party - FREE

cards.heading: Sponsor a Show
cards.blurb:
Help make live music possible!

Through your sponsorship, you’ll be supporting unforgettable events and helping to make high-quality live performances a reality. Whether you’re a business or an individual, every contribution helps ensure artists are paid fairly and creates unique experiences for the audience.
bullets: Brand presence : Visibility on our website, social media and at live events.
Advertising opportunities : Your logo on promotional materials, as well as on-site and online promotion.
Local involvement : Support the regional music and cultural scene and become part of our community.
Flexible partnerships : Tailored sponsorship packages, tailored to your objectives and budget.
